test_title: PYST 34: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4. **
solution: The correct answer is: **Frequent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Frequent **means occurring often or regularly. (अक्सर या नियमित रूप से घटित होना) • **Example**: *Sarah was a frequent visitor to the local library.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits with the context of the sentence. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Fast **means moving or being able to move quickly. (तेजी से चलना या चलने में सक्षम होना) • **Rare **means not occurring often or uncommonly. (अक्सर या असामान्य रूप से नहीं घटित होना) • **Speedy **means happening quickly or at a fast pace. (तेजी से या तेज गति से घटित होना) 4b:T9b0, The correct answer is: **Proactive**.
